# Adapter flow control

The flow-control rules are stated in
[the adapter protocol](../../spec/15_external-api-surface.md#1544-flow-control),
an anchor the document it addresses does not declare and the anchor-move map
retires no reference into. The pass leaves it exactly as it is written, and the
fragment-link gate is what reports it, because the hand correction that repairs
it is outside this migration.
